Validation by model group

Source: vignettes/articles/validation-model-groups.Rmd
validation-model-groups.Rmd

This page compares RSYC predictions with plot observations for every combination of response, model scale, and spatial level (model release v20260923). Each point is one age class of one curve: the weighted mean of the plot observations (x axis) against the mean RSYC prediction for the same plots (y axis). Panels show the generic model, the coniferous and broadleaf models, and the species models. Species are ordered by number of points.

Below each scatterplot, boxplots show the prediction error (RSYC − plot) by age class. AGB points with plot means of 400 Mg/ha or more are excluded, and panels with fewer than three points are omitted. See Model validation for the method and the Validation explorer for individual curves.
